name: mojulo
description: The mojulo plugin, published by Franz Ombico from the zombico/mojulo repository: a local MCP server that turns Claude into a game studio.

plugins.name: mojulo
plugins.description: Turn Claude into a game studio: you direct, Claude builds the levels, the cast, the feel, the look and the sound as small recipes on your machine, played in the browser and exported to Godot, glTF or STL/3MF. No account, no external telemetry.
